{"code": "import statsmodels.api as sm

# Create a logistic regression model to estimate the treatment effect adjusted for severity and age
# First, create dummy variables for severity
df_model = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=['severity'], prefix='severity', drop_first=True)

# Add a constant for intercept
X = df_model[['age', 'severity_moderate', 'severity_severe', 'arm_treatment']]
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Define the outcome
y = df_model['responded']

# Fit the model
model = sm.Logit(y, X).fit()

# Extract the coefficient for treatment (arm_treatment)
treatment_coeff = model.params['arm_treatment']

# Convert log-odds to probability difference using average marginal effects
# Compute average marginal effect of treatment
marginal_effect = model.get_margeff(at='overall').margeff[3]  # Index 3 is arm_treatment

# Output results
treatment_coeff, marginal_effect"}
